description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Habarakada, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District (25/55047)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including specific parcel numbers, land extents, and cadastral details. It involves legal notices calling for claims to property under the Registration of Title Act, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
